meta.source: col25 campaign (methods A-D and the blind adjudication), frozen per frame; the per-method pipelines are described in latte_imex/rig/column_foot.py
meta.units: U, V: board x, y about the registered disc centre [mm] (V < 0 toward the pitcher in the deposit windows); sU, sV: the method's validated 1 sigma [mm]; disc_c [m], zs [m] board; t: sim clock [s]
meta.record_U_mm: lateral fallback only (a V-only frame with no U measurement takes the record's U)
